description: Controlled rendered-workload timings, not isolated GPU pass times or gameplay FPS.
notes: Same fixed office seed/camera and 480-line 3D source across all cases. Film grain remains0.4 in every case; no-effects means all compared video stages off.
Each production case has two rounds in opposite order, six batches of30 draws per round. Each batch has a single final readback fence.
No-present synchronized batch means include CPU submission, GPU completion and amortized image readback. Percentiles describe batch averages.
GPU timestamps unavailable on this Metal driver. Invalid texture-memory counters are null.
The full matrix uses LDR2D. Core routes separately use production linear/HDR2D canvases; HDR display output stays disabled.
4K full-matrix rounds varied materially. Preserve both rounds; do not interpret a mean as a guaranteed frame rate.
No-present batch includes CPU submission plus GPU completion and amortized single image readback.
Batch percentiles describe 30-frame averages, not individual GPU frame latency.
Normal fallback may retain OS display pacing despite disabled VSync and frame limit.
Effect clocks advance by1/60 per force_draw; automatic glitches are disabled.
World height is fixed identically across all cases (default480), independently of output dimensions.
